justification: I inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/function/package-info.java`, `IOStream.java`, `Uncheck.java`, `Erase.java`, `IOConsumer.java`, `IOFunction.java`, and `IOIterator.java`, plus the full package file list under `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/function/`. The package has 35 production files, but they are tightly focused on one concern: IO-aware functional interfaces, stream/iterator/spliterator wrappers, and exception-translation helpers. Only three files are relatively large (`IOStream.java` 602 LOC, `Uncheck.java` 391 LOC, `Erase.java` 191 LOC); the rest are small interfaces/adapters, and the package docs explicitly say it provides “IO-only related functional interfaces,” so there is no strong evidence of a god component or mixed responsibility hub.
